title: Young Folks
lyrics:
[00:36.23]If I told you things I did before, told you how I used to be
[00:43.65]Would you go along with someone like me?

[00:57.52]Would you go along with someone like me?

[01:17.85]It doesn't matter what you did, who you were hanging with
[01:25.28]We could stick around and see this night through
